mapper.select: SELECT b.id,b.payload_hash FROM bike_stock_out_batch b JOIN bike_pi p ON p.series_id=b.series_id WHERE p.id=#{piId} AND b.operator_id=#{operatorId} AND b.request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT id FROM bike_stock_out_batch WHERE batch_no=#{batchNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_stock_out_batch_item(stock_out_id,batch_id,sku_id) SELECT so.id,b.id,pv.sku_id FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_pi_order_link l ON l.order_id=so.order_id JOIN bike_stock_out_batch b ON b.id=#{batchId} AND b.series_id=l.series_id AND b.customer_id=so.customer_id LEFT JOIN bike_production_vehicle pv ON pv.vehicle_id=so.vehicle_id WHERE so.stock_out_no=#{stockNo} AND so.status='COMPLETED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM bike_stock_out_batch b JOIN bike_pi p ON p.id=#{piId} WHERE b.id=#{batchId} AND b.series_id=p.series_id AND b.execution_pi_id=p.id AND b.customer_id=p.customer_id
mapper.sql: SELECT b.id,b.batch_no,b.series_id,b.execution_pi_id,b.customer_id,b.source_type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(so.status='COMPLETED'),0)=0 THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN SUM(so.status='COMPLETED')=COUNT(*) THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'PARTIALLY_CANCELLED' END status, COUNT(i.stock_out_id) original_qty,COALESCE(SUM(so.status='COMPLETED'),0) active_qty,b.created_at FROM bike_stock_out_batch b LEFT JOIN bike_stock_out_batch_item i ON i.batch_id=b.id LEFT JOIN bike_stock_out_record so ON so.id=i.stock_out_id
mapper.select: WHERE b.series_id=(SELECT series_id FROM bike_pi WHERE id=#{piId}) GROUP BY b.id ORDER BY b.id DESC

SELECT so.id stockOutId,so.stock_out_no stockOutNo,so.order_id orderId,o.order_no orderNo, so.vehicle_id vehicleId,v.vehicle_qr_code vehicleQrCode,v.frame_sn frameSn,i.sku_id skuId,s.sku_code skuCode,so.status,so.cancel_reason cancelReason FROM bike_stock_out_batch_item i JOIN bike_stock_out_record so ON so.id=i.stock_out_id JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=so.order_id JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=so.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN bike_production_sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id WHERE i.batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY so.id
mapper.sql: p.status='RELEASED' AND p.release_status='RELEASED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_user_customer_scope cs WHERE cs.user_id=#{customerScopeUser} AND cs.customer_id=p.customer_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_order_link l JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=l.order_id WHERE l.series_id=p.series_id AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PARTIAL_SHIPPED')) AND (p.pi_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.pi_no piNo,p.customer_id customerId,p.customer_name customerName,p.planned_ship_date plannedShipDate FROM bike_pi_series s JOIN bike_pi p ON p.id=s.current_pi_id WHERE ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_pi_series s JOIN bike_pi p ON p.id=s.current_pi_id WHERE

SELECT p.id,p.pi_no piNo,p.customer_id customerId,p.customer_name customerName,p.status, p.planned_ship_date plannedShipDate FROM bike_pi_series s JOIN bike_pi p ON p.id=s.current_pi_id WHERE p.id=#{piId}

SELECT s.pi_no,p.revision execution_revision,b.batch_no,b.source_type FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_stock_out_batch_item i ON i.stock_out_id=so.id JOIN bike_stock_out_batch b ON b.id=i.batch_id JOIN bike_pi_series s ON s.id=b.series_id LEFT JOIN bike_pi p ON p.id=b.execution_pi_id WHERE so.stock_out_no=#{stockNo}
